settings.heading: GIVE $10 / GET $10
settings.content:
Our Ambassador program is based on a simple, “pay-it-forward” referral program we call “Give $10 / Get $10.”

You can give out your code online or “Shake & Share” a product sample on the court.
Why is this program so great?
Because you make $10 EVERY TIME your friends order 5 Point Zero.
(Not just the first time they order.)

Unlike other companies that make you “apply” to represent their products,
we appreciate all pickleball players who want to share a healthy product with their friends. 
Become a “pro-sumer” (making money on products you love and share) instead of a “consumer”
(spending money on products and earning no income when you share or recommend).

Whether you know 1 other pickleball player or 1,001 ...

settings.heading: HOW IT WORKS
settings.content:
You choose a referral code.
When your friend makes a 5 Point Zero purchase with your code,
THEY receive a $10 DISCOUNT on their first product order
PLUS every future product order and
YOU receive $10 IN CASH or PRODUCT CREDIT on their first product order PLUS every future product order they place.

This Customer is CODED to you.
They always save $10.
You always earn $10.
Every product order.
Period.

To earn cash instead of product credits, you just need a PayPal or Venmo account so we can direct deposit the money you earn from your Referrals.

Perfect for pickleball Facebook Group administrators, social media influencers, pickleball instructors, tournament directors or anyone who interacts with large groups of players.
